scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @portfolio/backend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build -w @portfolio/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/backend && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/frontend
